title: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2610.28340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accura

translated_title: DeclineCraft：一个用于联合衡量检索知识与参数知识组合的RAG弃答基准
translated_abstract: 可靠的检索增强生成（RAG）需要模型能够识别何时检索到的文档和参数知识都无法支持答案。我们提出了DeclineCraft，一个动态弃答基准，其不可回答的问题针对语料库截止日期之后Minecraft游戏中新增的功能特性，并对可能存在的参数化知识暴露进行了审计。较晚的语料库截止日期还可支持对未来模型的评估。我们在27个大语言模型上测量了正确弃答率（CAR；即模型在不可回答问题上承认知识不足的频率）、可回答问题尝试率以及答案准确率。我们发现：（1）与无检索相比，单次检索在40个配置（模型与思考模式设置）中的38个里显著提高了CAR；（2）迭代式RAG——即模型对自身上下文进行自我评估并可请求最多两轮额外检索——在40个配置中的30个里相比单次RAG显著降低了CAR（平均46.4%），而答案准确率几乎没有变化。
tldr: 该论文提出了DeclineCraft——一个基于Minecraft语料库截止日期的动态RAG弃答基准，发现单次检索能显著提升模型在不可回答问题上的正确弃答率，而允许模型自主多轮检索的迭代式RAG反而会降低弃答能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces DeclineCraft, a dynamic RAG abstention benchmark based on Minecraft corpus cut-offs, showing that single-shot retrieval significantly improves correct abstention rates on unanswerable questions, while iterative RAG with self-assessed additional retrieval rounds actually lowers abstention performance.
